findings.title: Successful save can delete the destination file when directory fsync fails
findings.evidence: The broad exception handler still unlinks tmp_path after the file has already been moved into place by os.replace, so any later exception from the post-rename directory fsync will remove the newly written state file.
findings.recommendation: Limit the cleanup handler to the pre-rename section, or track whether os.replace has already succeeded and skip os.unlink(tmp_path) once ownership has moved to the destination path. A common pattern is to wrap only temp-file creation/writing and os.replace in the try/except, then fsync the directory in a separate step that does not attempt to unlink the temp path.
